description: Voie piétonne - Pays d'Aix is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by agglo-paysdaix.fr. Location of pedestrian paths on the territory. A pedestrian lane is a lane generally without sidewalks, reserved primarily for pedestrians, vehicle traffic is restricted by the installation of removable posts or terminals at the various access points of the street. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Pedestrian route - Pays d'Aix" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include piétonisation ; donnée ouverte. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
